metas.name: The Dream Life of Mr. Kim
metas.description: Kim Nak-su is a middle-aged man who loses everything he once considered valuable in an instant. After a long journey, he finally discovers his true self, beyond his role as a department manager at a large corporation.

metas.name: Entrepreneurs
metas.description: קבוצה של יזמים יוצאת בכל יום לחלל עבודה משותף בחיפוש אחר הצלחה.

metas.name: Lazarus
metas.description: After experiencing a personal loss, Lazarus begins having disturbing experiences that can't be explained.

metas.name: The Monster of Florence
metas.description: As a serial killer strikes terror in Italy by targeting couples parked in lovers lanes, authorities explore a case from 1968 that may be key to identifying The Monster of Florence.

metas.name: Mob War: Philadelphia vs. The Mafia
metas.description: Philadelphia is the City of Brotherly Love, but in the '90s, it was a bloodbath. Two warring mob factions battle for control in this true-crime series.

metas.name: The Guest
metas.description: A cleaner becomes captivated by her wealthy employer's charismatic influence. As their intense friendship grows and secrets emerge, their relationship spirals into a dangerous psychological game where nothing is quite what it seems.

metas.name: Mr. Scorsese
metas.description: Follows the life and career of legendary filmmaker Martin Scorsese.

metas.name: Hollywood Hustler: Glitz, Glam, Scam
metas.description: From Midwest dreamer to Hollywood fraudster, Zach Horwitz constructs an elaborate over $650 million Hollywood scam to finance his obsessive quest for stardom. His former inner circle recount how Zach preyed on their trust while living extravagantly, but when investors stop receiving payments, the facade crumbles, exposing the depths of his deception.

metas.name: Devil in Disguise: John Wayne Gacy
metas.description: Chicago-area contractor John Wayne Gacy leads a double-life as a serial killer, while detectives piece together clues that lead to a shocking discovery.

metas.name: Murdaugh: Death in the Family
metas.description: Follow Alex Murdaugh's stranger-than-fiction family drama, tale based on Mandy Matney's hours of reporting as well as exclusive insights from years spent on the case.

metas.name: No One Saw Us Leave
metas.description: Follows a mother desperately pursuing her husband who kidnapped their children, highlighting the clash between two powerful Jewish families in the 1960s.

metas.name: Typhoon Family
metas.description: CEO Kang Tae Pung runs Typhoon Company, his family business. His father cherished it like family. Since inheriting it after his father's death, he's fought to save it, especially during the 1997 IMF crisis.

metas.name: The Last Frontier
metas.description: Follows Frank Remnick, a U.S. Marshal in charge of the quiet and weathered barrens of Alaska, as he needs to deal with a prison transport plane crash full of violent inmates inside his jurisdiction.

metas.name: Old Money
metas.description: A bold, self-made mogul faces of with an old-money diplomat. Can love find its way amidst a power struggle, where wealth and wit collide?

metas.name: Boots
metas.description: Bullied gay teen Cameron joins the Marine Corps with his best friend despite risks. In boot camp they experience profound personal change amid danger, as their platoon confronts both literal and figurative landmines.

metas.name: The Resurrected
metas.description: Follows the journey of two desperate mothers as they resurrect a deceased ringleader of a telecommunication fraud scheme to avenge their kidnapped daughters.

metas.name: Néro: The Assassin
metas.description: Southern France, 16th century. Our hero, a minion in the service of a power-hungry nobleman, is going to have to save his own daughter, who is in danger but whom he barely knows.

metas.name: Fate
metas.description: Taxi driver David becomes the chauffeur for a famous bullfighter known as El Maestro, who is attempting a comeback after years away from the ring. El Maestro's perspective changes, and he starts seeing David as a good luck charm.

metas.name: Is It Cake? Halloween
metas.description: עוגה או זיוף? ממתק או תעלול? אופים מיומנים מכינים עוגות הלואין מציאותיות במיוחד. מהדורה חגיגית של התחרות הפופולרית.

metas.name: Film Club
metas.description: Two movie enthusiasts, Noa and Evie, share a weekly film club where their unspoken feelings for each other grow. When Noa decides to move away for work, Evie has a limited time to confess her love before potentially losing him for...

metas.name: Dr. Seuss's Horton!
metas.description: Young Horton explores the Jungle of Nool with his two best friends: going on daring adventures, helping their community, and learning how to stand up for what's fair.

metas.name: Genie, Make a Wish
metas.description: Iblis, a genie who awakens after almost a thousand years, and Ka-young, his new impassive master.

metas.name: Watching You
metas.description: Lina is happily engaged, but a chance encounter with a stranger culminates in a one-night stand. When the affair is secretly filmed and used to blackmail her, she hunts the voyeur, only to discover the danger is far closer than she could imagine.

metas.name: Dudes
metas.description: In the midst of a masculinity crisis, four friends in their forties are losing their throne, privileges and identity; years ago, they would have been alpha males in charge of their lives, but they have had to live in the era of equality.

metas.name: The Sisters Grimm
metas.description: One year after their parents' mysterious disappearance, sisters Sabrina and Daphne move to a magical town where fairytales are real and secrets lurk behind every corner.

metas.name: Nightmares of Nature
metas.description: Chilling tales of survival unfurl in this documentary series that captures the drama, danger and dark beauty of nature from the perspective of its prey.

metas.name: Death in Apartment 603: What Happened to Ellen Greenberg?
metas.description: Explores the death of Ellen Greenberg, initially ruled a suicide, her family insists she was murdered.

metas.name: The Murky Stream
metas.description: The fates of a man with a hidden past, a wise and just woman, and an upright man intertwine.

metas.name: Cat's Eye
metas.description: By day, sisters Hitomi, Rui and Ai run the popular Cat's Eye Café; by night, they slip into the shadows, executing high-stakes art heists with precision and style.

metas.name: Wayward
metas.description: A bucolic but sinister town explores the insidious intricacies of the troubled teen industry, and the eternal struggle of the next generation.

metas.name: Hotel Costiera
metas.description: Daniel De Luca is a half-Italian ex-marine who returns to Italy, the land of his childhood, and takes up problem solving in one of the most luxurious hotels in the world, located on the spectacular coast of Positano.

metas.name: The Hack
metas.description: While a journalist uncovers evidence of phone hacking at a tabloid newspaper, a former police detective looks into the unsolved murder of a private investigator.

metas.name: Sneaker Wars: Adidas V. Puma
metas.description: Through unprecedented access to both companies, uncover the tale of two feuding brothers, Adi and Rudi Dassler, whose multi-decade rivalry and competition helped shape the modern sportswear industry.

metas.name: The Guest
metas.description: A seemingly perfect household unravels when an unexpected visitor arrives, exposing hidden tensions and political aspirations that threaten to tear the family apart.

metas.name: Crime Scene Zero
metas.description: In this mystery showdown, players engage in layered scenarios as either suspects or detectives — each striving to outsmart others and uncover the truth.

metas.name: Billionaires' Bunker
metas.description: When World War III is about to break out, a group of billionaires takes refuge in a luxury bunker. Through screens, they watch the spectacle of the world they knew collapsing above their heads.

metas.name: Black Rabbit
metas.description: When the owner of a New York City hotspot allows his turbulent brother back in his life, he opens the door to escalating dangers that threaten to bring down everything he's built.

metas.name: Call My Agent Berlin
metas.description: Welcome to Stern Talent Agency, where stars, drama, and intrigue are part of daily life. After the founder’s death, the agency faces collapse. Only by discovering new talent, keeping old stars, and securing smart deals can it survive. Behind the scenes, the agents fight with passion — for their clients and for their own future.

metas.name: Maledictions
metas.description: At a career-defining moment, a governor's child vanishes. Torn between ambition and family secrets, he must choose: politics or his daughter's safety.

metas.name: The Girlfriend
metas.description: Laura's idyllic life is shattered when her son's new girlfriend seems suspicious. She's determined to protect him, but her actions spiral out of control. Is she justifiably cautious or consumed by paranoia?

metas.name: The Dead Girls
metas.description: Follows the murderous Baladro sisters which crimes were inspired by the Mexican serial killers known as Las Poquianchis.

metas.name: Tempest
metas.description: Munju, an ex-ambassador, and Sanho, a secret agent, investigate an attack that could destabilize the Korean peninsula, unraveling a dangerous conspiracy that jeopardizes regional peace and security.

metas.name: NCIS: Tony & Ziva
metas.description: After Ziva's apparent death, Tony raises their daughter Tali. Years later, Ziva returns and reunites with Tony. Tony's company is attacked, and the family travels to Europe to learn who's after them and how to trust each other again.

metas.name: Suga
metas.description: After his daughter's tragic death, Suga, the leader of a notorious motorcycle club, struggles to hold his fractured family and gang together. As rival crews and a relentless prosecutor close in, his world shatters when his own brotherhood betrays him. Now, he faces an impossible choice: reclaim his lost power or protect his grieving family.

metas.name: The Runarounds
metas.description: A group of high school graduates from Wilmington, North Carolina, come together to form a rock band, united by their shared love of music and dream of stardom.

metas.name: Two Graves
metas.description: After her 16-year-old granddaughter Verónica and her friend Mandy disappear, Isabel starts an unsanctioned investigation to uncover the truth behind their vanishing, embarking on a journey of vengeance.

metas.name: Playing Nice
metas.description: Two couples discover their toddlers were switched at birth in a hospital mix-up and face the horrifying dilemma of keeping the sons they have raised and loved, or reclaiming their biological child.

metas.name: Aema
metas.description: In 1980s Korea, a movie star and a starlet defy male-dominated industry rules and backstage corruption while filming the provocative "Madame Aema."

metas.name: Hostage
metas.description: When the PM's husband is kidnapped and the visiting French President is blackmailed, the two political leaders face unimaginable choices. Forced into a fierce rivalry can they work together to uncover the plot that threatens them ...

metas.name: The Twisted Tale of Amanda Knox
metas.description: Centers on Amanda Knox's harrowing journey after being wrongfully imprisoned for her roommate's murder, her battle to prove her innocence and regain her freedom.

metas.name: Rivers of Fate
metas.description: Three strangers' lives collide in the Amazon: Janalice, kidnapped by traffickers; Preá, a reluctant gang leader; Mariangel, seeking vengeance for her family's murder.

metas.name: Butterfly
metas.description: When the consequences of a decision from his past come back to haunt him, a former intelligence operative finds himself pursued by a sociopathic agent assigned to kill him.

metas.name: Necaxa
metas.description: Beloved Mexican soccer team Club Necaxa strives to reclaim their place as one of Mexico's top teams, while their Mexican-American owner Eva Longoria tries to breathe new life into the team by enlisting the help of her high-profile friends including new co-owners Rob Mac and Ryan Reynolds.

metas.name: Capturing Their Killer: The Girls on the High Bridge
metas.description: In the bucolic town of Delphi, Indiana, 13-year-old Abigail Williams and 14-year-old Liberty German set out for a walk on a warm February afternoon in 2017 - and never came home. Their bodies were discovered the next day in a wooded area not far from the trail, setting off a five-year-long search that gripped the nation and haunted this close-knit community.

metas.name: Beyond the Bar
metas.description: A young, rookie lawyer with a strong sense of justice joins a top law firm - navigating the complex legal world under a cold, demanding mentor.

metas.name: Eyes of Wakanda
metas.description: Wakandan warriors who, throughout history, have traveled the world to retrieve dangerous vibranium artifacts.

metas.name: Unspeakable Sins
metas.description: Trapped in a controlling marriage, a woman starts an affair with a younger man for comfort and revenge, but their liaison transforms into a perilous battle to stay alive.

metas.name: Mr. & Mrs. Murder
metas.description: Four close friends' seemingly perfect lives unravel after one vanishes on a hunting trip. Nearly 20 years later, the truth emerges with devastating consequences.

metas.name: Hurricane Katrina: Race Against Time
metas.description: Offers the most intimate and profound exploration into the wide-ranging impacts of the Hurricane Katrina disaster to date. Weaving together critical moments of the crisis and the past events that precipitated it, the series delivers an unparalleled, emotionally raw examination of the storm’s personal, political and societal fallout.

metas.name: Trigger
metas.description: About two men who are trying to solve a mess after firearms are suddenly widely available in South Korea, which used to be a gun-free country, through an unknown source.

metas.name: The Winning Try
metas.description: A disgraced former rugby star returns as a coach to his high school’s struggling team, where he reunites with his ex-girlfriend and helps the determined captain lead the team to redemption.

metas.name: Mandala Murders
metas.description: In a quaint mysterious town of Charandaspur, where fate, myth, and murder entwine, detectives Rea Thomas and Vikram Singh unravel a chilling conspiracy of ritualistic killings tied to a centuries-old secret society.

metas.name: Washington Black
metas.description: Follows the 19th century adventures of George Washington "Wash" Black, an 11-year-old boy on a Barbados sugar plantation who must flee after a gruesome death threatens to turn his life upside down.

metas.name: Letters from the Past
metas.description: When a young woman discovers a long-buried secret about her past, she must trace back a collection of letters to their writers to uncover the truth.

metas.name: Billy Joel: And So It Goes
metas.description: Showcases an extensive look at Billy Joel's life and music career, featuring exclusive interviews, performances, home movies, and personal photographs.

metas.name: Superstar
metas.description: Set deep in the chaos of the early 2000s, this series reimagines the life of pop icon Tamara — and her metamorphosis into Yurena — as never seen before.

metas.name: Delirium
metas.description: When his wife Agustina falls into delirium, a professor delves into her dark past to piece together her story and uncover the cause of her madness.

metas.name: Catalog
metas.description: A recently widowed workaholic clumsily navigates life with his kids, guided by his late wife's online tips. Can he ace this crash course in parenthood?

metas.name: Low Life
metas.description: A dangerous story of rough people obsessed with shameless greed who gather together with their own greed and logic to find underwater artifacts off the coast of Shinan.

metas.name: Her Last Broadcast: The Abduction of Jodi Huisentruit
metas.description: In 1995, rising TV news anchor Jodi Huisentruit disappeared from her Iowa apartment just before dawn, leaving behind signs of a violent abduction. Her case quickly became one of the nation’s most haunting unsolved mysteries. Now, 30 years later, “Her Last Broadcast: The Abduction of Jodi Huisentruit” follows a major break that reenergized the case.

metas.name: The Wild Ones
metas.description: Explore hidden corners of Earth with a trio of experts as they try to save six endangered species from extinction. With crafty camerawork and survival skills, the team race to find, record, and protect these elusive creatures before it's too late.

metas.name: Too Much
metas.description: After a breakup, New York workaholic Jessica moves to London planning on being alone. She meets Felix who causes her to reconsider finding love again.

metas.name: Suspicious Minds
metas.description: The professional thief Amber joins a wedding in Isla Esperanza with a target to steal the 24 million euro Tiara of Santa Agueda. It gets a bit more complicated when her previous partner in crime appears with the same agenda

metas.name: Off Road
metas.description: Raz and Sela, embark on a journey through Kyrgyzstan and Kazakhstan, exploring Central Asian landscapes while testing their friendship and personal convictions.

metas.name: Under a Dark Sun
metas.description: A woman fleeing her past faces murder charges after her flower farm employer dies.

metas.name: All the Sharks
metas.description: Four teams of shark experts and enthusiasts travel the globe trying to find the most elusive shark species in this fin-tastic reality competition.

metas.name: Attack on London: Hunting the 7/7 Bombers
metas.description: Eyewitness accounts and previously unreleased footage reveal the 2005 London transport bombings and subsequent events.

metas.name: Smoke
metas.description: A troubled detective and an enigmatic arson investigator follow in the footsteps of two serial arsonists.

metas.name: Countdown
metas.description: An LAPD officer joins a secret task force to investigate a suspicious murder, but uncovers a sinister plot that requires the team to unite and save millions in the city.

metas.name: Ironheart
metas.description: Genius teenage inventor Riri Williams creates the most advanced suit of armor since Iron Man.

metas.name: Olympo
metas.description: When a swimmer collapses at a high-performance sports center, Amaia investigates the extreme risks her fellow athletes are taking to feed their ambition.

metas.name: The Waterfront
metas.description: As their storied North Carolina fishing empire decays, the damaged Buckleys grapple to revive their imperiled maritime heritage.

metas.name: Outrageous
metas.description: Based on the story of the Mitford sisters, six sisters who refused to play by the rules and whose often-scandalous lives made headlines around the world. Set in the 1930s, it is a tale of betrayal, scandal, heartache and even impr...

metas.name: Reminder
metas.description: Deniz, a reliable, famous architect, and Güneş, a phenomenal editor, who decided to separate six months ago while on their way to a wedding, are swept into a journey that will change their lives with a message that arrives on their phones on the evening of the day they met by chance. This new adventure will make them discover the missing pieces of their old relationship and remind them of love.

metas.name: Underdogs
metas.description: Follow the story of the heroic underdogs of the natural world – the good, the bad and the frankly ugly. From their hidden talents to their bold hygiene choices, unsavory courtship rituals, devious camouflage techniques and “tough love” parenting skills, Underdogs will celebrate and champion the unique and unpredictable behaviors of a little known and surprising cast of animal characters.

metas.name: ROMCON: Who the F**k Is Jason Porter?
metas.description: Discover how Toronto real estate broker Heather Rovet's perfect romance with "Jace" shattered upon discovering he was Jason Porter, a convicted felon with a history of romantic fraud. Connecting with other victims, Heather transforms from heartbroken lover to determined investigator, risking everything to expose his pattern of manipulation and seek justice.

metas.name: Call Her Alex
metas.description: "Call Her Daddy" creator, host and executive producer Alex Cooper is at the top of her game, signing one of the biggest deals in podcast history. This revealing two-part series gives audiences a behind-the-scenes, intimate look at her journey and the defining moments that shaped her influential voice.

metas.name: Mercy for None
metas.description: After severing ties with his gang, a former gangster returns to uncover the truth behind his brother's death, embarking on a relentless path of revenge.

metas.name: The Survivors
metas.description: Fifteen years ago, a storm devastated the coastal town of Evelyn Bay and took three young people: Kieran's older brother, Finn, Mia's best friend, Gabby, and Finn's friend, Toby. Burdened by guilt, Kieran and Mia escaped.

metas.name: Power Moves with Shaquille O'Neal
metas.description: NBA legends Shaquille O'Neal and Allen Iverson work to revive Reebok's legacy and find a rising star to rep the brand.

metas.name: The Mortician
metas.description: A family funeral home in 1980s Pasadena, under David Sconce's leadership, betrayed public trust by exploiting bereaved families and the deceased through unethical practices to maximize profits.

metas.name: The Better Sister
metas.description: Two estranged sisters, Chloe (Jessica Biel) and Nicky (Elizabeth Banks), one married to and the other divorced from the same man, Adam (Corey Stoll), are forced together after he is murdered.

metas.name: Mad Unicorn
metas.description: Giving up his street life, a young man breaks new ground with the launch of a startup business that brings new opportunities and powerful enemies.

metas.name: F1: The Academy
metas.description: Fifteen young women break barriers in one of the world's most demanding sports as they race to get a female driver back on the Formula 1 grid.

metas.name: Cold Case: The Tylenol Murders
metas.description: It explores 1980s Chicago deaths from cyanide-laced Tylenol capsules. The case led to tamper-proof packaging and became one of America's largest criminal investigations.

metas.name: Kevin Costner's the West
metas.description: Explores through multi-layered portrait of American frontier from literal trailblazers to the law enforcers and battles for both land and freedom.

metas.name: Diddy on Trial: As It Happened
metas.description: The trial of Sean "Diddy" Combs has begun, and prosecutors allege he engaged in an extensive list of criminal activities, including federal racketeering, sex trafficking and more. Combs denies all accusations, maintaining his innocence. In this new weekly series, viewers can witness it all unfold in real time.

metas.name: Our Unwritten Seoul
metas.description: Identical twin sisters with opposite lives - one a former athlete living freely, the other a corporate perfectionist switch places with each other, despite their contrasting personalities.

metas.name: Pee-wee as Himself
metas.description: A kaleidoscopic portrait told in two parts that traces the life of the imaginative artist.

metas.name: Forget You Not
metas.description: An aspiring stand-up comedian turns her struggles into heartfelt humor as she balances work and relationships while caring for her aging father.
